For 4 months after Killua’s passing, I worked on this painting as I processed her loss. Her ashes are a part of the moon, the trees, the vast landscape reaching into the endless horizon, forever running free. I named the piece “Eternal Sleep”. I wanted to encapsulate the monumental grief, love, and beauty that resides within both life and death. We cannot escape the wheel of time, and in comparison to the past 3.7 billion years of life on earth, we are nothing but a speck of dust. Despite this reality, our experiences and connections to others continue to feel deeply profound. In order to suffer such unimaginable grief, one must first experience such incredible love and joy.

If you are interested in a print of this painting, I do have them available on my art page @enchanted.forest 🤍
